title: A stoppable heartbeat
hints: for range time.Tick(…) never ends: the channel is never closed, and nothing in the loop checks stop.
Use time.NewTicker and a select with two cases, one for ticker.C and one for stop. Return from the stop case and defer ticker.Stop().
ticker := time.NewTicker(interval); defer ticker.Stop(); for { select { case <-ticker.C: beat(); case <-stop: return } }
